annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.note: Check the oil level often: early engines can burn oil, and running low damages the engine.
RepairPal lists about $291-$383 per axle, by year.
Rear calipers and parking brake cables can seize; have them checked at the same time.

maint.every: About every 100,000–120,000 miles for iridium plugs
maint.note: RepairPal lists about $97-$171 for 2000-2002 and $120-$228 for 2003-2005. The engine sits behind the seats.

maint.job: Engine coolant drain, refill and bleed
maint.every: Follow the owner's manual; usually every 2–5 years by coolant type
maint.note: The mid-engine layout means long coolant pipes that must be bled of air. RepairPal lists about $545-$648 for 2000-2003 and $358-$460 for 2004-2005.
